description: This file defines configuration settings and environment parsing for CUDA memory allocator in PyTorch, including deprecated methods, environment variable parsing, and platform-specific handling.

classes.name: CUDAAllocatorConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for CUDA allocator settings, including environment parsing and platform-specific handling.

methods.name: max_split_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum split size for memory allocation, deprecated in favor of a different config.

methods.name: garbage_collection_threshold
methods.description: Returns the garbage collection threshold, deprecated in favor of a different config.

methods.name: expandable_segments
methods.description: Checks if expandable segments are enabled, with platform-specific support.

methods.name: expandable_segments_handle_type
methods.description: Gets the handle type for expandable segments.

methods.name: set_expandable_segments_handle_type
methods.description: Sets the handle type for expandable segments.

methods.name: release_lock_on_cudamalloc
methods.description: Indicates if lock is released on CUDA malloc.

methods.name: graph_capture_record_stream_reuse
methods.description: Indicates if stream reuse is enabled during graph capture.

methods.name: per_process_memory_fraction
methods.description: Returns the fraction of memory allocated per process.

methods.name: pinned_use_cuda_host_register
methods.description: Checks if CUDA host registration is used for pinned memory.

methods.name: pinned_num_register_threads
methods.description: Returns the number of threads used for pinned memory registration.

methods.name: pinned_use_background_threads
methods.description: Deprecated: Checks if background threads are used for pinned memory.

methods.name: pinned_reserve_segment_size_mb
methods.description: Returns the reserved segment size in MB for pinned memory.

methods.name: pinned_max_register_threads
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of threads for pinned memory registration (fixed at 128).

methods.name: roundup_power2_divisions
methods.description: Deprecated: Returns divisions for power-of-two rounding, with overload for size parameter.

methods.name: max_non_split_rounding_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum size for non-split rounding.

methods.name: last_allocator_settings
methods.description: Deprecated: Returns last allocator settings as string.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses environment variable string for configuration.
